zoe: Heads up: PR #4287 updates prefix cache headers. Quick Q about contract: if we stream tokens, do we still set x-rw-cache-hit at start or append at end? Need to be explicit for SDK and clients.

kyung: iirc we set header on initial response meta. Streaming keeps sending chunked body; header can't change mid-stream. so sdk should trust initial header. @mike correct?

mike: Correct. Plan was to set x-rw-cache-hit: true|false on initial response. When we fall back to a compatible smaller model we set x-rw-cache-variant: model-v2 and x-rw-cache-hit stays true only if cache matched that variant. If mismatch -> hit=false. Example response headers we expect:```HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/event-stream
x-rw-cache-hit: true
x-rw-cache-variant: model-v1
x-rw-cache-partial: false
```

zoe: That helps. Edgecases: what about prefix-key namespacing? We added tenant hash in key, but do we expose hit=tenant-level or global? We need consistent semantics for multi-tenant customers.

ben: We decided hit semantics are tenant-scoped. So cache key = sha(tenant_id + normalized_prompt + model_variant + prefix_version). We'll document that in API contract. Also adding header x-rw-cache-namespace: tenant is useful for observability.

mike: Also CI note: if KV is warming and we stream 'partial' prefix from prefill, we may still mark as miss because the full prefix isn't present. That's a common source of flakiness — clients will see different latencies between partial vs full hits.

kyung: Proposal: add a header x-rw-cache-partial: true|false when some but not all prefix blocks are present. That gives SDKs a signal they can use for telemetry.

zoe: Nice. Agree. Implementation plan: PR attaches these headers for hosted mode; Dedicated/Private will default to same contract unless overridden. Can someone add unit tests for streaming + header behavior?

mike: @ben i'll add tests for streaming (unit + small integration). @kyung can you add doc snippet in /docs/api/cache.md with header table and semantics? Also confirm backward compat: older clients that only read x-rw-cache-hit should continue to work.

ben: will do. quick checklist: 1) set x-rw-cache-hit at response start; 2) add x-rw-cache-variant when a fallback model is used; 3) add x-rw-cache-partial when prefill/partial prefix present; 4) document tenant-scoping and key derivation; 5) deprecation note for legacy header x-cache. :thumbsup:

cache-ci-bot: build passed for PR #4287 (unit tests + integration). Deploy window 11:30 UTC.

zoe: :ok_hand: thanks all. I'll tag eng-docs and update the rollout notes.
